_meta.note: 16 seed transport legs. Legs are symmetric unless 'oneWay' is true (the engine may reverse from/to). 'publicTransport': scheduled | limited | none. Only options with status 'verified' may show a checkmark; everything else shows 'est.' Durations in minutes, costs in JOD. 'oneWayVerified': the timetable was checked in the from→to direction only; reversed, options with departure times are shown as est. with no times.
_meta.fallback: For any pair not listed: road km = haversine * 1.35, drive time = km / 70 km/h, publicTransport = 'none', taxi/driver est = 0.30–0.40 JOD per km (min 15). Flag as 'est'.

options.label: Airport taxi
options.notes: Fixed-fare desk outside arrivals: you get a receipt with the price before boarding (22.50 JOD to Amman reported 2023–2024). Night fares may be higher.
options.source: guides: alongdustyroads.com 22.50 JOD 'correct as of February 2024'; thatladyfromeurope.com 22.50 (Jan 2023, page updated Oct 2025); wikivoyage ~22.5; jordan-spirit.com 2026 25–30 day / 30–35 night

options.label: Airport Express bus
options.source: sariyahexpress.com — Airport Express - Sariyah (timetable table on the page)
options.notes: Sariyah Airport Express: North Station (Tabarbour) · Seventh Circle · airport. From the airport 06:00, 07:00, then every 30 min 08:00–18:00, then hourly 19:00–05:00. From North Station every 30 min 06:15–17:30, then hourly 18:00–00:00. Fridays hourly.

options.label: JETT bus Abdali → Wadi Musa
options.source: jett.com.jo booking system — checked 24 Sep 2026 for travel 25 Sep (screenshot on file; the public site shows times/fares only inside the booking form)
options.notes: One daily departure — miss it and the day is gone.

legs.timeSensitive: Sunset jeep tours need arrival before ~16:00.
legs.evidence: Wadi Rum is not bookable in JETT's booking system (checked 24 Sep 2026) although the JETT homepage lists it.

options.label: Pre-arranged transfer
options.notes: Book through your camp or a licensed driver; fixed price agreed in advance. Camps quote about 40 JOD per car (sedan, up to 4 people).
options.source: wadirumnomads.com (camp/tour operator, 11 Mar 2025): 40 JOD per car; jordan-spirit.com 2026: 35–50; twowanderingsoles (via search) 35–40

options.label: Rum Bus shared shuttle (Wadi Musa 06:00–06:30)
options.source: wadirumnomads.com (camp/tour operator) — Rum Bus (Petra–Wadi Rum Bus)
options.notes: One operator's own shuttle, leaves early — you lose the Petra morning; arrives Wadi Rum ~09:00.

options.label: Taxi from Wadi Musa
options.notes: Agree the fare before leaving; availability varies in the afternoon.

options.label: Bus via Aqaba + taxi
options.notes: Adds a change in Aqaba; not practical for this day.

options.label: Minibus from North station (Tabarbour)
options.notes: Regulated fare 1.10 JOD (LTRC tariff). No timetable: minibuses leave North station (Tabarbour) when full; last returns early evening.
options.source: ltrc.gov.jo — Land Transport Regulatory Commission, قوائم الأجور → «الخطوط الرئيسية» fare list (PDF created 7 May 2026; list page last modified 2026/07/30)

options.label: Taxi / driver
options.source: 3 guides 2026: continenthop.com (20–25 one way), jordan-spirit.com (20–30), TripAdvisor forum (~25)
options.notes: Guides 2026: 20–25 JOD one way by taxi; agree the fare first. Return trip negotiated separately.

options.label: Minibus from Muhajireen station to the Dead Sea rest house (via Suweimeh)
options.notes: Fare from the regulator's licensed-line list. Team note: no published timetable — leaves when full, mostly mornings; not practical for a same-day return.

options.source: ltrc.gov.jo — Land Transport Regulatory Commission, قوائم الأجور → «الخطوط الرئيسية» fare list (PDF created 7 May 2026; list page last modified 2026/07/30)
options.notes: Regulated fare 0.60 JOD (LTRC tariff). No timetable: minibuses leave the South station (Mujamma al-Janoubi) when full.

legs.warning: Jerash is north of Amman and the Dead Sea is south-west — no direct bus, and hours on the road.
